title: Local dimension of a pure-dimensional locally algebraic open
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $Y$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with a locally finite type morphism $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], $O\subseteq Y$ an open, and $n\in\mathbb N$. Suppose every irreducible component $C$ of $O$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] has topological Krull dimension $n$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then for every $x\in O$ the local topological dimension of $Y$ at $x$ [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] is $n$.

proof.text: Regard O as an open subscheme locally of finite type over k. Choose an affine neighbourhood A of x in O. The components of A through x correspond to the components of O through x by intersection. Their dimensions remain n by Stacks 0A21 (3). Part (5) of the same source computes local dimension at x as the maximum of the dimensions of the components through x. At least one such component exists; all dimensions are n, so the maximum is n. The open-subspace equality transports this dimension from A to O and Y. The affine-neighbourhood argument needs only local finite type; empty O has no x.

theorem topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_of_equidimensional_open
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (O : Y.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ C ∈ irreducibleComponents ↥O, topologicalKrullDim C = (n : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (x : Y) (hx : x ∈ O) : topologicalKrullDimAt x = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
